question: What enjoyment with divine maidens becomes possible for the practitioner?
premises: Many divine maidens can be attracted.
They are enjoyed after being attracted.
This is addressed to the beloved.
inference: Having attracted many divine maidens, they enjoy them, O beloved.
uncertainties: The subject of bhuñjate is not explicitly stated in this verse.
plain_english: Having attracted many divine maidens, they enjoy them, O beloved.
